decisions.reason: The registered PHP target Order/refund does not exist; the controller only defines refundForm and refundOld, while the GET form route is also incorrectly wired to Order/refund.
decisions.replacement: GET /kefuapi/order/refund_form/:id for the form and PUT /kefuapi/refund/refund/:id for an authorized after-sale refund

decisions.reason: The PHP GET mutates refund state, ignores the path parameter, reads a query parameter with the same name, and writes an order-status row using the refund id as oid.
